description: Hand-labelled gold sample of 50 helpdesk tickets for entity-level NER evaluation. Written independently of the generator templates and the extraction rules, deliberately including unusual formats (ERR-504, E1021, lowercase IDs, Indian number grouping, unseen course prefixes) so the evaluation exposes real weaknesses. Annotation guideline: PERSON = name without honorific; DATE = the date expression without preposition (relative dates like 'yesterday' count); LOCATION = specific campus place; SYSTEM = named software/platform/payment rail; DEPARTMENT = named university office. Teams should extend/verify this file by hand.
